additional_info.subject: 0458299 - ID0458299-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S7 313806942001] Log Check CRM:00472000432
additional_info.body:
Dear Vanshika,
We're sending out a quick heads-up about a specific behavior you might observe with AWS logs following a system shutdown.
We understand that after a system shutdown, you might see a temporary, intense stream of logs. We want to assure you that this log surge is a known and expected behavior. It typically lasts only a few minutes and clears out on its own, usually in less than 10 minutes.
What you need to know:
No Action Required:
These are transient events, and no service actions or investigations are needed from your side. The situation resolves automatically.
R&D is Aware:
This topic has already been communicated to our R&D team, and they are actively working on a solution.
Anticipated Fix:
A fix to limit this log stream is anticipated to be included with the upcoming FW release v8.1.
Please Refrain from Opening Tickets:
To help us streamline our support efforts, please refrain from opening tickets for this specific behavior.
We appreciate your understanding and cooperation as our R&D team works to implement the fix. This proactive communication aims to keep everyone informed and reduce unnecessary ticket submissions.
I will proceed to close this ticket.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
